note: Frozen. Facts restate docs/decisions/* records; queries are paraphrases written before any run. Change => bump version.

facts.fact: Risk tiers stay advisory and nothing is auto-approved until P-D6 is decided.
The W31 allocation module is only a proposal source behind the approval boundary with no dispatch or vendoring.
Hx is the agent workflow language; Hermes and .hms files are out of scope.
Verification-first mode is switched on by default.
Billing stays disabled until the payment provider confirms seller eligibility.
The multiplayer build is deferred; design work only, no build authorization.
Learned memory and skills are proposals only and never applied automatically.
External agents receive observer leases with empty authority; requested scope is never applied.
Self-host first and preserve a later managed cloud option.
No public launch under the colliding product name before counsel trademark clearance.
Members choose their own approval rendering and an admin may set it for a member.
AI proposes assignments and an admin approves every assignment.
